A '''KL-45 coolant hydro-valve''' was a type of [[hydrovalve]] that was manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] used a number of KL-45 coolant hydro-valves in the environmental control systems of its [[Obas base|base]] in the [[Obas system/Legends|Obas system]].

==Description==
A KL-45 coolant hydro-valve was a type of [[hydrovalve]] that was used in the [[Power conduit/Legends|power conduit]] of environmental control systems. They were manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and transported in cases in groups of at least thirty valves per case.<ref name="Instant Adventures" />

==History==
KL-45 coolant hydro-valves were during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During which the Empire kept several cases of hydro-valve at its [[Imperial supply depot (Rainos Cluster)|supply depot]] in the [[Rainos Cluster/Legends|Rainos Cluster]],<ref name="Instant Adventures" /> a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|expansion region]]. <ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The Rebel Alliance operated a [[Obas base|base]] on the superheated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obas]] nearby the Rainos Cluster. In order to withstand the planet's [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] conditions, the base made use of a number of KL-45 coolant hydro-valves in its environmental control systems to regulate the heat.<ref name="Instant Adventures" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Instant Adventures Date">''[[Instant Adventures]]'' states that all of its roleplaying adventures take place between the events the films {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] respectively. Thus the events of the adventure must fall between those two dates.</ref> the environmental control systems of the Obas base malfunctioned, endangering the lives of the base and its personnel.<ref name="Instant Adventures" /> 

{{RPG|"[[Meltdown (adventure)|Meltdown]]"}}
{{Quote|''NEW ORDERS'': Procure 30 SoroSuub KL-45 coolant hydro-valves. Best local source is Imperial supply depot in Rainos Cluster.|Message from the Obas base to a group of Rebel Alliance agents|<ref name="Instant Adventures" />}}
The base personnel&mdash;who were all trapped in the base's control center due to the failing environmental systems&mdash;managed to send a message to a group of Rebel agents at the edge of the [[Obas system/Legends|star system]] to inform them of the situation. The message also directed the Rebels to acquire the replacement hydro-valves at the nearby Rainos Cluster supply depot. The group quickly [[Mission to the Imperial supply depot|departed]] for the depot where they were able to retrieve the required replacements. After returning to the base and finding a way inside, the Rebels were able to install the valves and route coolant to the base's systems.<ref name="Instant Adventures" /> 
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
KL-45 coolant hydro-valves appeared in "[[Meltdown (adventure)|Meltdown]]," a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure published by [[West End Games]] in the roleplaying supplement ''[[Instant Adventures]]'' in [[1997]]. During the adventure, the players have the option of bluffing their way on to the supply depot or attacking the station to acquire the hydro-valves.<ref name="Instant Adventures" />
